Bring Your A-Game — AI Agent Idea

DesignSync

When the cloud changes, the design shouldn't be left behind.

1What would you like to call your AI agent?

DesignSync

2The problem

Cloud and infrastructure changes happen regularly, but the corresponding Low-Level Design often still has to be updated manually. Engineers need to find the latest document, work out which sections changed, update wording and diagrams, and keep everything aligned with design standards. It is repetitive work and easy for documentation to fall behind the real environment.

3The solution

DesignSync takes the existing LLD, the proposed cloud or infrastructure change and the organisation's design rules. It identifies the sections affected and creates an updated draft for human review, including proposed changes to tables, components and design descriptions. The first version can simply generate a local draft; later it could integrate directly with Confluence.
